rows.text: Beyond the five basic senses, many species possess one or two additional sensory faculties, but Etherlanders, with their ethereal antennae, can perceive a full nine. After integrating with the Interastral Peace Corporation's markets, Etherlanders were compelled to remodel themselves in the human image, enduring great suffering to assimilate into galactic society, their once-celebrated senses fading into regression. Recently, a movement among certain Etherlanders has sparked a cultural revival: Using the genetic blueprints of ancient ancestors, a new generation of infants with their original sensory capabilities has been brought into the world. Yet every single one of these healthy newborns perished shortly after leaving the incubator — their ethereal antennae were simply too sensitive, and the universe today is saturated with lethal levels of etheric interference.
